history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). They are both wearing matching navy blue athletic jackets with white accents on the sleeves and sides. Behind them, other individuals are visible, including a young person wearing a tan baseball cap and a red jacket, and others in the background. Overhead, the ceiling features a modern design with wooden slats and white beams. Yellow directional signs with arrows are mounted on poles in the background, indicating pathways. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor public space. The color palette is dominated by the navy blue of the jackets, contrasted with white, red, and the warm tones of the ceiling. The overall mood is one of anticipation or travel, possibly related to a sporting event or competition. The image is a medium shot, focusing on the upper bodies of the two boys.
